Paragraph: "Listen, Rama! O valiant prince, control your grief and assemble your innate strength; despair destroys all resolves!"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Lakshmana observes Rama sinking deeper into overwhelming grief and loss of resolve.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana intervenes firmly, offering grounding support and urging self-regulation.
Outcome/Resolution: Rama receives strong supportive intervention from his brother to break the spiral of despair.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Dhairyavalambana (Anchoring oneself in fortitude and inner strength)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Lakshmana embodies the protective guru/friend guiding the grieving soul back to its inherent divine fortitude.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Crisis intervention: a trusted support figure providing firm cognitive reframing to interrupt emotional spiraling.
